Not by default. December 22nd falls inside the year-end code freeze (Dec 15 to Jan 5), while Finance runs the annual close. No production release can go out in that window, hotfixes included, unless a lead in #fin-eng signs off in the channel first.

- **To release on the 22nd:** get that sign-off in #fin-eng before tagging. Since Finance asked for the fix, they may be able to sort it out quickly. I can't verify or request the sign-off from here.
- **Otherwise:** ship before Dec 15 (the 14th is a Monday) or wait until after Jan 5.
- **Day of the week:** Dec 22 is a Tuesday, so the "no Fridays after 14:00 UTC" rule doesn't apply.
- **Process:** if you do get approval, the process is the usual one. Complete the PR template checklist, then tag `vYYYY.MM.N` from main (here `v2026.12.N`). CI publishes, and someone on the billing team has to approve the production promotion in the CI UI. Any migrations the fix needs must ship in the same release.

It's October 5th now, so there's plenty of time to land the fix and release before the freeze starts.
